I answered Tobias in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread: the ticket is **#88412**.

He posted it himself in #central-team on 2025-07-02 as the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging, which was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis corrected the name to Tansleigh Packaging in the same thread, so this isn't the similarly named Tansley Parcel.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, and so is everyone in this incident channel. A ticket number counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share there. I didn't use `search_messages`.
